name: Rollganic Rosin Disposable | The Spice!
description:
.5g Rosin Disposable

The flavor profile is for gas lovers, a strong Gassy smell with licorice, anise, pepper, and cloves. This is one of our strongest hitting live resin strains with a sedative, appetite stimulating and sleep inducing effects.
